question: Who among the following leaders received the 'Lifetime Achievement Award' during the 13th Sansad Ratna Awards?
solution:
The correct answer is __**TK Rangarajan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** TK Rangarajan:-**

 
 
• He received the Lifetime Achievement Award during the 13th Sansad Ratna Awards.
 
• TK Rangarajan is a former Member of Parliament (MP) who served in the Rajya Sabha from 2004 to 2010 and in the Lok Sabha from 2014 to 2019. He is a member of the Communist Party of India (Marxist) and has been actively involved in politics since the 1970s.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** Chandrababu Naidu:-**

 
 
• He is a prominent politician from Andhra Pradesh who served as the Chief Minister of the state for several terms.
 
• He is the founder of the Telugu Desam Party and has been active in politics since the 1980s.
 
 
 
• **Kumar Mangalam:-**
 
 
• He is a business tycoon and the Chairman of Aditya Birla Group, one of India's largest conglomerates.
 
 
 
• **Sumitra Mahajan:-**
 
 
• He is a veteran politician from the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) who served as the Speaker of the Lok Sabha from 2014 to 2019.
